suites.title: portal - real MAIN sign-in, workspaces, authorization

specs.title: signed-out visitors get a sign-in prompt on private pages and the API answers 401
sign up in MAIN -> portal onboarding -> workspace -> notes with plan quota; second user cannot see the data
plan limit is enforced and explained in the UI
an expired portal token is renewed silently from the live MAIN session; sign-out ends access at once
tampered / garbage portal cookies are refused (and MAIN has no session to renew from)
billing page: owner sees plan and invoices area; billing details stay hidden from plain members

suites.title: pricing page - prices come only from the server catalogue

specs.title: [I04][I05] displayed prices equal the database-backed API (monthly and annual), with computed saving
[I06] annual/monthly switch works with the mouse and the keyboard and exposes its state
seat count changes the displayed total
[I13] a price change in PostgreSQL shows on the page after reload; nothing is cached or hard-coded
[I14] annual billing is disabled (not invented) when a plan has no annual price row
[I15] catalogue unavailable => explicit "unavailable" state, buying disabled, NO fallback prices; Retry recovers
when the server says checkout is not available, purchase buttons are disabled with an explanation
[I12] Enterprise "Contact sales" creates a real inquiry in PostgreSQL (and the honeypot does not)
signed-out visitors who click Buy are sent to sign in and come back to pricing
[I10] signed-in Buy creates a SERVER-SIDE checkout with the database price; the redirect alone activates nothing; a verified webhook does
notes are private by default, searchable and filed in notebooks; a colleague in the same workspace sees none of it
documents: create, edit with version history and restore, optimistic-concurrency conflict, and sharing as read-only
sheets and slides edit and persist; AI draft is labelled and private (test-double model)
QorllaMate proposes, the user approves, and only then does the note exist; email stays blocked (test-double model)
